SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS average_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes AS t
JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
WHERE t.equipstatus <> 'Maintenance'
GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage
ORDER BY telescope_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
